name: OpenVoiceOS
description: An independent non-profit foundation building a community-driven, privacy-respecting open-source voice-AI platform. TigreGótico is a core contributor to OpenVoiceOS, and its founder serves on the foundation's board.

name: Alpha Cephei
description: A speech-recognition partnership bringing decades of automatic speech recognition (ASR) expertise — the team behind Vosk and Kaldi-based models — to our voice-model fine-tuning and dataset work.

name: ILENIA
description: A one-time subcontracted project to bring Catalan, Spanish, Galician, and Basque support to OpenVoiceOS and improve its localization tooling — delivering STT and TTS plugins and dialog/normalization components for those languages.

name: NLnet / NGI0 Commons Fund
description: Internet-for-all funding program supporting the development of privacy-first voice technology — sponsoring wake-word training, localization, and open-source voice AI infrastructure.
